Adorable art style with a well written and often emotional story too. It's kind of like a cute choose your own adventure with branching paths that takes the story in different directions. …

writing is a little corny. but it is cute story. i enjoyed it much more than i was expecting :) the ending leaves a lot to be desired though. many plot threads are not tied up from alternative time lines
小朋友们在镇上的假期冒险故事！悬疑要素有一些，但使我印象深刻的是萌萌相处： 小猫小鹿雷雨夜谈心……Luka和Rolo吵架两只毛绒绒眼泪汪汪地说你是bad friend！，还有Rola动员了半个镇子的解谜道歉 ，哎呀，被萌倒。
玩法有趣，美术优秀，角色塑造不错，多结局分支内容也不会重复又补充了世界观，值得一玩 猫猫Beck好酷，Valentine一家都好好看，立绘画的很生动，喜欢！！
